demoNotice: Fictional data only. No cloud sync, real sign-in, paid AI or messages to others.
lead: Start with yourself. Add the relationships you choose, whenever you’re ready.
review: Review the mock draft. Edit it until it feels like you.
emptyEntries: Your first reflection can be small. It still counts.
emptyCheckins: A quiet inbox. Make room for a small check-in when you want.
mockPrompt: What could make today feel a little lighter?
mockDraft: Today I want to make room for one small thing that matters to me.
emptyRelationships: Zero, one or many. Your relationships are yours to define.
relationshipScope: Private tracking only in this demo. Invites and shared access are not connected yet.
notReady: This area is planned, not connected. Your private check-in already works on Home.
errorMessage: Couldn’t complete that action. Check that the local API and worker are running, then try again.
errorConflict: This check-in changed or expired. The latest version is now shown.
cloudSetup: Private cloud access requires a verified email and beta admission.
cloudMode: Private cloud sync · mock AI only · no outbound messages
betaPending: Your account is not admitted to this private beta yet.
authError: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and email confirmation.
confirmationSent: If eligible, you’ll receive a confirmation email. Open it in this browser to finish.
recoverySent: If eligible, you’ll receive a recovery email. Open it in this browser to continue.
authLinkError: This sign-in link could not be completed. It may have expired or belong to another browser. Start again.
authActionError: Couldn’t complete that request. Check your details or try again later.
authUnavailable: Account services are unavailable. Try again shortly.
betaExplanation: Access is by invitation. If someone invited you, open their invite link in this browser while signed in to this account. Creating an account does not share your content.
authLinkExpired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new link and open it immediately in the same browser/profile.
authLinkBrowser: Start recovery again in this browser/profile, then open the new email link here.
inviteUnavailable: This invitation is unavailable. It may be expired, replaced, cancelled, or intended for a different verified account.
inviteSignIn: Sign in with the email address this invitation was sent to. Accepting it also gives that account access to the beta.
membershipPrivacy: Members see this relationship’s name and chosen aliases. Your private reflections and other private content stay private.
joinConsent: I want to join this relationship.
invitationRules: Every current member must approve each invitation. Membership changes cancel pending invitations. Joining also requires beta admission.
membershipError: Couldn’t complete this action. Refresh to check membership and approvals, then try again.
aliasShared: Your chosen name is visible to members and to the intended recipient reviewing an approved invitation.
blockExplanation: Prevents contact between you and this person. Nobody is removed, and other members can still interact with either of you.
linkOnly: Create a link to share yourself; no email is sent. It expires after seven days. Replacing it disables the previous link.
invitationExpired: This link expired. Cancel it and propose a new invitation.
leaveExplanation: Leaving stops future contact in this relationship. Your private reflections remain. Rejoining needs a fresh, unanimously approved invitation.
sharingPolicy: Private by default. Share a fixed copy with only the people you select. Read only; no app forwarding or AI permission. Revoke future access at any time. Saved screenshots and external copies cannot be recalled.
sharingError: Access changed or the request failed. Refresh and try again.
sharingNoRecipients: No eligible recipients in this relationship.
workerUnavailable: Scheduled check-ins are temporarily unavailable. Try refreshing shortly.
scheduleNotice: Off by default. Schedules create private mock check-ins only; no AI calls or messages to others. Saving cancels old scheduled work.
aiConsentNotice: Changes save immediately. These private preferences do not share content or enable live AI. Every provider and capability needs separate approval; all processing remains disabled for now.
aiJournals: Allow saved reflections as future AI context
aiSourcesLater: Documents and chat context will become available when those features are ready.
aiReviewPending: Provider review pending. Approval is unavailable.
aiApproveProvider: Approve this provider for this capability
aiFallback: Allow automatic fallback to this approved capability
budgetNotice: Live AI is disabled. This is a personal safety ceiling, not a prepaid balance. Shared app limits also apply. Unknown costs keep their hold; hosting and storage are separate.
budgetAlert: At least {{level}}% of your ceiling is used or held.
soonPlannedNote: Nothing in this list works yet. It is here so you know what to expect.
growthPurpose: A private place for your own goals, habits and milestones, which will work whether or not you track any relationship.
growthPlanGoals: Set goals in your own words and come back to them when you choose.
growthPlanHabits: Switch on only the habits you want to keep track of.
growthPlanMilestones: Mark the milestones that matter to you.
growthPlanStreaks: See optional streaks that stay private and never scold you for a missed day.
bartenderPurpose: A friendly, plain-spoken AI to talk things through with, which is not therapy, will say so, and stays off until you approve a provider.
bartenderPlanTalk: Talk through whatever is on your mind, in your own words.
bartenderPlanDrafts: Get suggestions as drafts; the last word stays yours.
bartenderPlanContext: It will use only the current conversation unless you choose to let it use what you have saved.
bartenderLimitTherapy: It is not therapy or a crisis service, and it will say so.
bartenderLimitProvider: It stays off until you approve an AI provider, and you can withdraw that approval.
bartenderLimitPrivate: What you keep private stays private; it will not pass it on to anyone in your relationships.
sharingNoReflections: Save a reflection first. Then you can share a copy of it here.
sharingNoRelationships: No relationship is available for sharing. Ones you archived or muted are left out.
sharingPickRelationship: Choose a relationship to see who can receive a copy.
sharingReviewHint: Nothing is shared until you confirm on the next step.
sharingSentEmpty: You have not shared any copies. Choose a reflection above to share one.
sharingEntryMissing: This reflection is not in your current list.
sharingOpenedHint: For privacy, this copy closes when access is rechecked or you leave this tab. Open it again to keep reading.
sharingShared: Copy shared. You can revoke future access below.
sharingRevokedDone: Access revoked. Saved screenshots and external copies cannot be recalled.
homeScopeCloud: Cloud check-ins are private and just for you for now.
relAllArchived: Your relationships are archived. Show archived relationships to view them.
relCreateHint: Name this space in your own words. Adding members is optional.
relEmptyCloud: No relationships yet. You can use this space on your own or create one below.
relEmptyLocal: No relationships in this fictional preview yet.
relMembershipHint: These choices affect your participation. Other members keep their own settings.
scheduleCadenceHint: Hours between check-ins during waking hours.
schedulePausedHint: Pause applies to all your schedules. Nothing is sent when you resume without a fresh check.
scheduleQueueHint: Queue one private mock check-in. This does not turn on scheduled check-ins.
scheduleQuietHint: Your timezone and quiet hours apply across all schedules.
scheduleScopeHint: Each relationship and solo space has its own schedule.
settingsNotLoaded: Settings have not loaded yet. Try again shortly.
settingsPreferencesLead: Choose the timezone used for your check-ins. Changes are saved only when you choose Save preferences.
settingsRhythmLead: Current preview defaults. Cloud scheduling has separate controls when you sign in.
settingsThemeHint: Follow your device or choose a light or dark appearance.
settingsTimezoneHint: Enter an IANA timezone, such as Europe/Rome.
supportLimits: This app is not an emergency service or professional care. It does not monitor you or contact anyone for you.
supportWithheldDetail: Generated content was withheld. This is not an assessment of you. Nothing was sent to another person.
supportDanger: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact emergency services where you are, if it is safe to do so.
supportCountry: Country or region you are in now
supportCountryHint: Optional; not saved or shared. Language does not determine your location.
supportStale: The saved contact information needs rechecking. Open the official source; no dial button is shown.
supportNoNumber: No verified emergency number is available for this selection. Use a local official source or the directories below.
supportExternal: External sites open only when you choose a link and have their own privacy practices. Availability, languages and eligibility vary.
supportCare: For health concerns, contact a doctor. A qualified therapist or local support service may help with emotional difficulties.
supportDevice: Quick exit opens Wikipedia. It does not erase browsing history or hide activity from device monitoring. Consider a safer device if someone may be monitoring yours.
supportWithheld: Some generated content was withheld. You can review support options privately.
supportNoticeError: This notice could not be updated. Help resources remain available.
supportPath_manual: You can choose support for yourself or someone you know. You do not need to add a relationship or share your story here.
supportPath_self_harm: You deserve support. If you might act on thoughts of harming yourself, seek immediate local help. If safe, reach out to someone you trust and avoid being alone.
supportPath_violence: Your safety matters. If safe, move away from immediate danger and seek local help. Avoid confronting someone if that could increase the danger.
supportPath_stalking: You deserve privacy and safety. A specialist support service can help you consider safer options. Avoid confronting someone or changing device settings if that could increase your risk.
supportPath_refuse: The app cannot help with harmful or privacy-invasive actions. You can choose general support resources instead.
supportPath_unavailable: The app could not complete its safety checks. It has held the content; no AI response is available.
recoveredDraftHint: This temporary edit can be cleared by a page or session change. Copy it now.
recoverySaved: Saved privately to your cloud account.
recoveryFailed: Could not save this edit. Copy it now or retry.
recoveryDeleteFailed: Could not dismiss this edit. Try again.
checkpointLocal: Private edit saved on this device; cloud sync pending.
checkpointCloud: Private edit saved in the cloud.
checkpointFailed: Could not save this edit on this device. Copy it now; cloud sync may still succeed.
checkpointRecoveredHint: This copy is private. It has not been sent or shared.
checkpointActionFailed: Could not update this copy. Keep it open and retry; it may have been discarded elsewhere.
checkpointDevicePrivacy: Edits are stored in this browser; people with access to this browser profile may be able to read them.
checkpointLoadFailed: Could not load private cloud edits. Copies on this device may still be shown.
relInviteNextStep: Everyone has approved. Create the invite link, then send it to them yourself; the app does not email it.
sharingOnlyYou: Only you are in this relationship so far. Invite someone from Relationships; once they join, you can share with them here.
